name: photo-chromatic-abstraction-style-1
title_zh: 把照片压成 1-5 个色块的色彩记忆抽象画
tagline_zh: 照片记不住细节？那就只留颜色。自适应平涂色块 + 源图提取的克制点缀，让色彩权重自己说话，适合色卡转译与色彩构成练。
tagline_en: Forget details, keep the hues. Adaptive flat fields plus 1-5 restrained source-derived accents turn any photo.
desc_en: Translate an uploaded or local photograph into a color-first chromatic-memory abstraction (Style 1) built from adaptive flat fields and 1-5 restrained, source-derived accents. Use for palette-memory composition, color-weight studies, minimalist color-block translation, 色块抽象、照片色彩记忆、色彩构成、照片色卡转译，or explicit Style-1 requests where broad color hierarchy matters more than subject placement. Do not use w
why_zh: 不靠构图叙事，只按色彩层级切分画面——色块边界由颜色权重自适应生成，点缀色严格取自原图。
why_en: It segments by color weight, not subject placement—flat fields adapt to tonal hierarchy, accents stay source-derived, yielding a.
limit_zh: 只认照片输入（上传或本地文件），不处理纯文字描述；输出为静态色块图，不生成矢量或可编辑分层；若原图色彩层次过杂。
limit_en: Input must be a photo (upload/local), not text; output is a static raster, no vector or layers; if source has chaotic color hierarchy, accents drop.
